title: AromaGen: Interactive Generation of Rich Olfactory Experiences with Multimodal Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.01650v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Smell's connections with food, memory, and social experience have motivated researchers to bring olfaction into interactive systems. Multimodal AI opens new possibilities for generating smells from natural language, yet it remains unclear whether pretrained models encode sufficient olfactory knowledge to translate language into perceptible compositions. We present AromaGen, an AI-powered 12-channel wearable olfactory system that maps free-form natural-language descriptions to 12 base odorants selected to cover a semantically derived olfactory space, while supporting iterative refinement through natural-language feedback. In a between-subjects study (N=60) across 50 real-world benchmark smells, participants distinguished AromaGen-generated target smells above chance in a three-alternative forced-choice task, with retrieval-augmented AI composition performing comparably to human-expert composition and zero-shot AI composition. translated_title: AromaGen：基于多模态语言模型的丰富嗅觉体验交互式生成
translated_abstract: 嗅觉与食物、记忆以及社会体验之间的联系，促使研究人员将嗅觉引入交互式系统中。多模态人工智能为从自然语言生成气味开辟了新的可能性，然而目前尚不清楚预训练模型是否编码了足够的嗅觉知识，从而能够将语言转化为可感知的气味组合。我们提出了AromaGen，这是一个由人工智能驱动的12通道可穿戴嗅觉系统，它将自由格式的自然语言描述映射到12种基础气味剂上，这些基础气味剂经过精心挑选以覆盖语义推导出的嗅觉空间，同时支持通过自然语言反馈进行迭代优化。在一项涵盖50种真实世界基准气味的被试间研究（N=60）中，参与者在三选一强迫选择任务中区分AromaGen生成的目标气味的表现显著高于随机水平，其中基于检索增强的AI气味组合的表现与人类专家组合以及零样本AI组合相当。
tldr: AromaGen是一个由多模态语言模型驱动的12通道可穿戴嗅觉系统，能够将自然语言描述转化为可感知的气味组合并支持迭代优化，用户实验表明其检索增强的AI气味组合效果与人类专家相当。
en_tdlr: AromaGen is an AI-powered 12-channel wearable olfactory system that translates natural-language descriptions into perceptible smell compositions with iterative refinement, and user studies show its retrieval-augmented AI composition performs comparably to human-expert composition.
